description: Tracks how full the agent's context window is and, near the limit, folds the oldest turns into frozen summary 'cars' (a compaction train) so long chats keep going — newest turns stay verbatim, and any compacted detail is still retrievable from the raw transcript.
skill_summary: Your own context window: the fill gauge, the automatic background 'compaction train' (oldest turns fold into frozen summary parts; newest stay verbatim), and three tools — compact_context to deliberately fold older turns yourself at a phase checkpoint, recall_compacted to read the ORIGINAL turns behind any summary part verbatim, and search_this_session to keyword-find where a detail lives across the whole conversation. Load this whenever the user asks what you can do about your context/memory filling up, whether you can compact or summarize, or before a long multi-phase task — and, crucially, whenever you suspect a detail you need has been compacted into a summary: don't guess, recall it. NOTE: you CAN compact on demand; do not tell the user compaction is automatic-only.

levels.off: Do NOT call compact_context yourself — leave all compaction to the automatic background threshold.
levels.balanced: Reserve compact_context for a rare, deliberate fold only at a clean checkpoint of a long multi-step project, when early settled turns are taking room you need next.
levels.eager: On big multi-step work, proactively call compact_context at each phase boundary to reclaim room before the next phase (still never mid-phase).

settings.label: Self-Compaction Posture

options.label: Balanced — only at clean phase checkpoints
Eager — free room proactively between phases

settings.hint: How willing the agent is to run compact_context ITSELF (separate from the always-on automatic compaction below). 'Off' tells it never to self-compact and leave it all to the automatic threshold. 'Balanced' (default) reserves the tool for a rare, deliberate fold at a finished phase of a long project. 'Eager' nudges it to proactively reclaim room at every phase boundary on big multi-step work. Affects only the agent's judgement about the manual tool; it never changes whether automatic compaction runs.

settings.label: Auto-Detect Window From Model
settings.hint: ON (default) sizes the context budget to the ACTIVE model's real context window, looked up automatically — so the fill gauge and compaction stay correct even when a chat is switched to a model with a different window. OFF uses the fixed number below instead. When a model isn't in the catalog, the fixed number below is the fallback either way.

settings.label: Context Token Limit (fallback / manual)
settings.hint: The window size to budget against when 'Auto-Detect' above is OFF, and the fallback when it's ON but the active model isn't in the catalog. The 'how full am I' gauge measures against the resulting limit, and compaction starts once the conversation passes the threshold below. 200,000 is a safe default.

settings.label: Compact At (fraction full)
settings.hint: How full the context has to get before old turns are summarized, as a fraction of the limit. 0.85 means 'start compacting at 85% full'. Lower = compacts sooner and more often (cheaper context, more summary calls); higher = waits longer (richer verbatim history, risk of bumping the limit).

settings.label: Keep Verbatim (fraction)
settings.hint: How much of the limit is always kept word-for-word as the most recent 'hot tail', even after compacting. 0.30 means the latest turns filling up to ~30% of the limit stay verbatim while everything older is folded into summary parts. Higher keeps more recent detail; lower frees more room.

settings.label: Compact In Chunks Of (fraction of window)
settings.hint: How big a slice of old conversation each summary 'part' is made from, as a fraction of the window. 0.25 means each frozen part is made from ~25% of the window's worth of aged-out turns. Expressed as a fraction so it scales with the model: ~25% is sensible whether the window is 32k or 1M.

settings.label: Summary Part Size (fraction of window)
settings.hint: Roughly how long each frozen summary part is, as a fraction of the window. With the chunk size above, 0.25 → 0.05 is a 5:1 compression done ONCE per part and never re-summarized. Bigger keeps more detail per part but costs more context.

settings.label: Max Summary Parts (before merge)
settings.hint: How many frozen summary parts the train may hold before the OLDEST few are merged into one coarser 'ancient history' part. This bounds total summary size on very long sessions. The raw transcript is never deleted — even merged-away detail stays retrievable. 10 parts at ~5% each ≈ half the window in summaries before merging.

settings.label: Summary Model (optional)
settings.hint: Optional model id used only to write the rolling summary (a cheap, fast model is ideal here). Leave blank to reuse the app's configured chat model. Example: deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash.
